rerun_logging: Append session-scoped records; ranking/plots use latest session
parameter_encoding: Scalar params exact; estimators/callables use repr; nonfinite defaults use strings
predict_warning_policy: Only LightGBM auto-generated feature-name warnings suppressed; ColumnTransformer fixes input schema
cv_scoring: .4 macro F1 + .6 mean High/Critical recall; no accuracy objective
cv_strategy: Expanding chronological prefixes with validation patients excluded from each fit prefix
calibration: Sigmoid and isotonic ensembles, fitted/calibrated inside training forward folds only; matching uncalibrated fold ensembles logged
runtime_accounting: Each fit/scoring interval measured; calibration parent runtimes include base-fit components, so rows are not all additive
bootstrap: 200 patient-cluster resamples conditional on fixed validation predictions, common seed
smote_limitation: Interpolates encoded ordinal and binary features into fractional values; not category-aware SMOTE
class_weights: Balanced multiclass sample weights computed inside every classifier fit, including XGBoost
decision_rules: Prespecified illustrative under-cost multipliers and High/Critical thresholds; no clinical-utility claim
ranking_formula: .30 High recall + .30 Critical recall - .15 under - .30 severe under - .10 over + .20 macro F1 - .10 Brier - .10 patient-bootstrap HC recall SD
holdout: The full labelled cohort was explored in earlier EDA/hypothesis analyses. This is a newly reserved modelling holdout, not fully blinded to prior exploration. No baseline model transform, prediction, evaluation, or tuning uses test requests.
adaptive_validation: Validation used repeatedly for development/ranking; shortlist estimates are selection-biased
safety_notice: Experimental output. Not a clinical decision.
